subject: general
question: Who wrote the famous Bangla novel ‘Pather Panchali?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bibhutibhushan Bandopadhyay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay's novel Pather Panchali** was made into a 1955 Satyajit Ray film of the same name.
 
• Pather Panchali is widely regarded as one of the most important literary works representing rural life.
 
• It follows the Roy family from their ancestral home in rural Bengal to Varanasi in quest of a better life, as well as the sorrow and loss they experience along the way.
 
• In the Bengali language, Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay was an Indian writer.
 
• Pather Panchali (The Song of the Road), Chander Pahar, and Aranyak are three of his most well-known compositions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee** also known as Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote **Anandamath**, a Bengali language book published in 1882 that is considered a classic of modern Bengali and Indian literature.
 
• **Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay **was an early twentieth-century Bengali novelist and short story writer.
 
• With Contextual Modernism in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, **Rabindranath Tagore** altered Bengali literature and music, as well as Indian art. His famous works are **Gitanjali, Gitabitan, Kabuliwala, Gora, Stray Birds, The Home and the World,** etc.
